value.rationale: It is a uniform exact spectral stability classification for all odd finite cutoff durations in a natural time-limited exponentially tapered Gabor family. The previously unclassified finite-damping optimal frequency is unique or an exactly located conjugate pair, the critical damping has an explicit asymptotic law, and its square-root onset quantifies sensitivity. The all-degree Chebyshev-arc mechanism is structurally motivated and not an arbitrary isolated parameter slice or a restatement of the m=3 formula.
